title: Show HN: Open-source engine running Gemma 4 26B in 2 GB RAM on any M-series Mac
summary: TurboFieldfare is a specialized inference engine that runs 4-bit quantized Gemma 4 26B on any M-series Mac using only ~2 GB of RAM, by streaming model weights from disk instead of loading them entirely into memory. Written in Swift and Metal, it pushes the limits of on-device AI by making models that don't physically fit in memory still runnable on consumer hardware.
problem_solved: Enables running large AI models (14GB weights) on devices with limited RAM by implementing memory-efficient weight streaming from disk.
why_valuable: Democratizes access to powerful AI by making large language models runnable entirely on local hardware without cloud dependency, even when model weights exceed available memory.
